_comment: Ten-recording mini benchmark. AMI excerpts are fixed; VoxConverse files are chosen by rules evaluated on the reference annotations inside the excerpt window (see vox_select), applied in order, each file used once. Windows were fixed before any system ran and are never changed per system.
excerpt_policy: Fixed 180 s window per recording (shorter if the file is shorter). Reference turns crossing the window edge are truncated at the edge (documented edge effect).

tag_rules.overlap_level: from cropped reference overlap ratio: low < 0.05, high >= 0.15, otherwise medium
tag_rules.short_turns: speaker changes per minute from cropped reference (reported, used only for vox slot 5)
tag_rules.unknown: any tag without documented evidence is 'unknown' and only matches the 'All' filter

coverage_gaps: telephone / narrowband: no openly licensed telephone corpus with diarization references is used (CALLHOME/DIHARD are LDC-licensed)
audio quality (clean vs noisy): no per-file metadata in AMI or VoxConverse; remains 'unknown' unless a documented listening check is added
informal conversation: not separately represented (AMI EN2002a is a non-scenario meeting, tagged meeting)
